verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (scoped endpoints for jobs, candidates, offers and webhooks), an official MCP server and an llms.txt index. Nothing mentions official client SDKs or libraries in any language. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so there is not even a published spec to generate SDKs from. For a SaaS platform this axis applies, so the absence of evidence is "none".
